modelingNotes: Manufacturer accessory table (Chapter 12, illustration 05365E00) lists 'Protection caps - for plug 32 A - 4 poles - 8571001140' (5-pole variant is 8571002140).
Mechanical protective cap with zero electrical terminals or circuit functions. It covers the plug pins to prevent soiling when unplugged; it does not electrically terminate, bond, or short any pin.
The 32 A and pole count identify the compatible legacy plug. No electrical voltage/current or standalone ingress rating is assigned to the cap. No bonding is inferred through its body or attachment.
The exact legacy accessory row is the identity evidence. Equivalence with current article number 150856 has not been established and is not asserted.

connectionCoverage.notes: Mechanical protection cap; no electrical terminals. Fit and any installed environmental protection depend on the specified 8571/12 4-pole (3 P + PE) plug and its mating/assembly state.
